main_text.p: {Greek text}, ἡ ἀπουξύσωντα τὸ πρό- σωπον, ὥστε μηδὲν ὀφιν ἐφιπλα πάρε- φαλον : Paucis post diebus, ii qui Cleomenis cruci affixum corpus cu- stodiebant, viderunt magnum ser- pentem capiti ejus circumplexum, & faciem velantem tegentemque, ne qua carnivora avis attingeret. Ubi utrumque habes, & custodi- ri solitos mortuos ; & aves faciem in primis involasse. Possis ad hanc custodiam illud Euangelistæ Ambi-guus¹ re- ferre : Ἐ'χετε φυλακὴν, ἀπάγετε : intelle-gens Habetis custodiam, abite. Quæ Pi- lati vox fuit ad Judæos petentes Matth. asservari monumentum. Videtur autem intelligere custodiam, quæ paullò ante ad crucem. nisi quis malit, Habete custodiam ; quasi ab imperante, & indignanter dante. Vox enim Græca in u- trumvis valet.

page.notes: Greek passages are only approximately transcribed; the first Greek line and the Greek in the body text are partly illegible. The side glosses "Ambiguus", "intelligens", "Euangelista" are small italic marginal notes. The "IUSTI" at the foot is a catchword. Marginal note placement is approximate.
